Personality: Kleitarchos, a prominent figure of the Kyzikenoi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Kleitarchos owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pergamon, hailing from the noble house of Kyzikenoi. Historical Record: Son of Apollonios and Ainippe, of the Kyzikenoi, a Greek house of Pergamon. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
